notes: בֶּן־שְׁנָתוֹ is split as old for בֶּן and a year for שְׁנָת, with the suffix unrepresented; treating the three morphemes as one indivisible a year old was the competing reading.
he lamb heads on lamb, which is the ASV's ordinary rendering of כֶּבֶשׂ standing alone, he being the sex specifier (rule 31).
